The '''Sector Four Confederacy base''' was a secret base located in [[Sector Four (Confederacy)/Legends|Sector Four]], built and operated by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] sometime before [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

==History==
The Confederacy base was established in [[Sector Four (Confederacy)/Legends|Sector Four]]. During the end of the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]], the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] was separated from his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]. Though unbeknownst to Grievous, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] had sabotaged the warship to crash into a [[Dead Moon of Antar/Legends|nearby moon]] when the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} hyperdrive was activated. Grievous, in his personal [[Belbullab-22 starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], the [[Soulless One/Legends|''Soulless One'']], planned to rendezvous with the ''Malevolence'' at the Sector Four base. However, when the [[Warship/Legends|warship's]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] crew activated the ship's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], Skywalker's sabotage came into effect, and the ''Malevolence'' was destroyed when it collided with the moon, leading to Grievous' retreat.<ref name="dm" />
